lambda_tuning: inner fit/tune split of the TRAINING pool only; lambda minimising tune-set log loss is applied to test

verdict.interpretation_rule: source-vs-global is the test that matters. Beating LAPLACE only shows the source prior beats shrinking toward 0.5, which the target's own base rate also does. Beating GLOBAL-SHRINKAGE, with its own tuned lambda, is what shows the source carries signal the target cannot supply about itself.
